title: Fragments
statement:
When does the change begin?
I don't think we ever notice.

Some moments change us so quietly that we don't notice them until much later. There isn't always a clear beginning or an obvious ending.

Fragments (Still) holds the same identity as the moving work — the same face passing through its own states — but stops inside it, at the point where one self has not quite finished becoming another.

The face isn't meant to represent one person. It reflects the quiet way time reshapes us: some parts becoming clearer, others slowly dissolving. The eyes don't ask for attention. They simply stay present while everything around them begins to change.

Perhaps the most meaningful changes are the ones we only recognise afterwards.
